The words of a hook, a case for each: a text written with the word any
old way, that text as it is laid out, the word written wrongly, and where
and why the reader refuses that. `WRITE_WORDS=1` on the test that reads
this writes what is laid out and what is refused, to be read before it is
kept.

=== hook.do
--- written
blueprint: w
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
on_success:
    - do: noop
--- laid
blueprint: w

steps:
  a: { do: noop }

on_success:
  - do: noop
--- wrong
blueprint: w
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
on_success:
    - do: nothing.like.it
--- refused 5:7
there is no action called `nothing.like.it`

=== hook.emit
--- written
blueprint: w
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
on_success:
    - emit: {topic: w.done}
--- laid
blueprint: w

steps:
  a: { do: noop }

on_success:
  - emit: { topic: w.done }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
on_success:
    - emit: 3
--- refused 5:7
`emit` needs `topic` (where to publish, e.g. `build.slow`)

=== hook.when
--- written
blueprint: w
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
on_success:
    - do: noop
      when: ${ 1 == 1 }
--- laid
blueprint: w

steps:
  a: { do: noop }

on_success:
  - do: noop
    when: ${ 1 == 1 }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
on_success:
    - do: noop
      when: ${ 1 + }
--- refused 6:13
`when`: the expression ends too soon

=== hook.with
--- written
blueprint: w
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
on_success:
    - do: log
      with: {message: hi}
--- laid
blueprint: w

steps:
  a: { do: noop }

on_success:
  - do: log
    with: { message: hi }
--- wrong
blueprint: w
steps:
    a: {do: noop}
on_success:
    - do: noop
      with: [a]
--- refused 6:13
`with` must be a mapping, found a list
